components.name: Chart/Feature importance
components.description: Explains one model decision (SHAP): which inputs pushed the score up or down. Bar: signed contributions around zero; Waterfall: from base rate through each feature to the final prediction. Diverging colours (pos-3 / neg-3), never categorical. Show top 7, group the rest as “Other features”. React: <FeatureImportance base contributions={[{ feature, value }]} variant="bar|waterfall" /&gt

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Show the top 7 features; group the rest as “Other features”.
Diverging colours only — never categorical.
Use plain-language feature names (“Debt ratio”, not “dti_v2”).
Waterfall must end exactly at the shown prediction.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
